content: Xicor X28C256 has SDP with the same AA/55/A0 + AA/55/80/AA/55/20 command shape but a TIGHTER inter-byte window: Xicor/ON-Semi tBLC is 100 us max vs Atmel 150 us. Empirically (TommyPROM 28C256-notes) Xicor parts tolerate ~200 us while Atmel parts hard-refuse to unlock outside spec. No readable SDP status bit on any 28C family.
